title: A Day in a WW1 Trench Was Worse Than You Think
style: premium 2D bold ink contours, coherent hand-crafted shapes, earthy blue/olive/brown with restrained ember orange; no photorealism

scenes.name: HOOK
scenes.environment: wet trench behind soldier; orange fire glow and smoke
scenes.acting: soldier breathing, eyes dart to orange flash, shallow fearful swallow
scenes.voiceover: A day in a World War One trench was hell.

beats.event: instant dramatic face reveal
eyes glance off-camera left
fire glow pulses behind shoulder
one incomplete blink, eyelids close and open
head shifts right 7 degrees, shoulders hunch
thin smoke crosses midground, not face
eyes settle directly toward viewer
hard motivated cut to muddy boots

scenes.name: WATER_MUD
scenes.acting: foot peels from suction mud, water ripples, visible cold shiver
scenes.voiceover: Men stood for hours in freezing water and thick mud.

beats.event: low frame shows both boots immersed to ankles
rain drip hits puddle foreground
right boot tries to lift and resists sticky mud
boot comes free; stretched mud line breaks
boot splashes down causing concentric ripples
cut to medium shot hunched body; hands rub forearms
shoulder shiver travels through coat
soldier looks down in disgust
cut on his gaze to dark boards

scenes.name: RATS
scenes.acting: rat scamper crosses foreground; soldier startles and grabs helmet
scenes.voiceover: Rats scurried between your boots. Even sleep was a gamble.

beats.event: rat nose appears behind left board
rat emerges; tail drags near shallow puddle
rat accelerates across board seams
soldier boot enters background of low shot
rat crosses directly ahead of boot
whip cut to soldier reaction medium shot
eyes widen and shoulders rise in anticipation
soldier hops sideways one step, weight shifts
helmet lifts slightly from forehead, rim rotates
left hand clamps helmet before it falls
rat exits under plank in background
soldier glares at rat exit, chest still racing
cut to food cup

scenes.name: FOOD
scenes.environment: overcast trench alcove and muted smoke
scenes.acting: hand lifts tin mug, nose wrinkles, soldier grimaces, steam coils
scenes.voiceover: Meals arrived cold, stale, or covered in mud. Bon appétit.

beats.event: tin mug sits in hand below chest, steam rises
soldier flexes wrist and starts raising cup
cup reaches under nose; shoulders tilt forward
eyebrows raise in uncertain curiosity
short sniff; nostrils narrow; hand hesitates
smell registers, eyes narrow
mouth twists into disgust and upper lip rises
cup retreats slowly from face
tiny comic beat: soldier studies lumpy contents
one exhausted eye roll, hold 0.4 seconds
steam curls toward camera
sound bridge to distant artillery

scenes.name: SHELLING
scenes.environment: sandbags, trench wall, visible skyline smoke
scenes.acting: soldier ducks with clear anticipation/impact/follow through; shell blast beyond trench
scenes.voiceover: Then without warning, shells could turn everything upside down.

beats.event: silence of brief anticipation, soldier stops chewing
distant whistling begins and face tightens
soldier turns ear toward offscreen right
arms begin to rise protectively
orange-white flash behind parapet, 2 frames maximum
soldier folds down into cover with knees and hips
debris arc enters from behind, never fills entire frame
camera shake 5 frames, restrained
rolling smoke occludes upper trench wall
dust falls vertically in foreground
soldier crouches holding helmet
slowly lifts only eyes above arms
falling debris fades, distant low rumble persists
hard audio cut to paper rustle

scenes.name: LETTER
scenes.camera: seated medium close-up and hand insert
scenes.environment: quiet sheltered trench, cold blue light
scenes.acting: soldier unfolds handwritten letter; eyes soften; paper flutter
scenes.voiceover: A letter from home might be the best moment of the week.

beats.event: gloved hands take damp folded envelope
right thumb breaks fold carefully
unfold one panel of letter
cut to mid shot; soldier lowers head to read
pupil tracks first line left to right
mouth corners warm slightly, no exaggerated grin
draft catches lower corner of page
soldier pins fluttering corner gently
eyes blink and emotion fades into uncertainty
close-up on letter and knuckles
distant whistle starts transition

scenes.name: OVER_TOP
scenes.environment: trench rim, ladder, smoke sky, distant wire
scenes.acting: hesitation at ladder; hand grips rung; meaningful weighted ascent
scenes.voiceover: And sometimes the order came: climb out into no man’s land.

beats.event: soldier stands at ladder base, looking up
hand hesitates beside rung
fingers grip first rung, knuckles tense
one boot plants on first rung
body compresses down preparing push
weighted upward lift from planted foot
other hand reaches next rung
other boot searches and finds higher rung
head breaks trench skyline
torso reaches parapet; silhouette clear
small pause at edge as wind moves coat
soldier begins step into dangerous light
cut before showing violence

scenes.name: ENDING
scenes.camera: intimate close-up with brief held silhouettes
scenes.environment: minimal distant smoke and near-black slate gradient
scenes.acting: hold on weary eyes and tiny motions; closing title lands, end with clean beat
scenes.voiceover: And some men lived like this for years. If they survived.

beats.event: cut to tight soldier face, wet smudges visible
eyes stare beyond frame into distance
barely perceptible controlled breath
distant ember dims behind him
small slow blink, single eyebrow tension
eyes drop toward ground; not a camera zoom substitute
eyes return halfway to viewer
on-screen final title completes word-by-word
sound bed thins; hold emotionally readable face
subtle cheek tremor / breath
last subtitle resolves; maintain scene image
clean end, no abrupt audio cut

shots.acting: rat runs on boards, leg in distance
hop, recoil, helmet catch and settle
pause then grab ladder and place foot
